guide.tetanusmod.weapons.body:
Iron Spear: three iron ingots, a chain and a stick. Seven base damage, slower than an iron sword. Right-click thrusts up to 4.5 blocks; walls obstruct it. A rusted spear inflicts Tetanus.

Tetanus I applies to melee weapons, bows, crossbows and tridents. Tetanus II also causes disorientation, erratic movement, missed mob attacks and two points of periodic nonlethal damage.

Tetanized arrows alone cause one minute of Tetanus. Enchanted bows cause full-strength infection; using both extends it by 25 percent. Infinity still consumes infected arrows.

Old rusted iron tools keep working in saves but are retired from new acquisition and this creative tab.

guide.tetanusmod.crafting.body:
Iron Spear: row 1 empty/iron/iron; row 2 empty/chain/iron; row 3 stick/empty/empty.

Rusted Iron Block: iron block surrounded by four Rust in a cross. The Tetanized Beacon accepts only this base block.

Bear Trap: iron/nail/iron; iron/heavy pressure plate/iron; chain below center. Reset a closed trap with a Trap Reset Tool. Rusty traps inflict Tetanus.

Barbed Wire: three nails across top and bottom; chain/string/chain across middle.

Medicine Cabinet: birch planks across top/bottom; honey bottle/barrel/fermented spider eye in middle. An unemployed villager can become a medic using it.

guide.tetanusmod.creatures.body:
Rusty contact can permanently mutate animals (%s%%) or other ordinary mobs (%s%%). Only permanent tetanized animals replace their ordinary drops with Infected Meat. Temporary Tetanus alone never changes animal loot.

Natural tetanized spawns: Easy 10 percent, Normal 15 percent, Hard 20 percent. Spawners use 25/35/45 percent. Withers keep their separate ritual.

Some mammals and undead can be rabid: thirty extra health points, leather-equivalent armor and five-point melee attacks. Rabid animals alone drop Rabid Meat.

Use creative variant spawn eggs for specific creatures, or operator commands for testing.
guide.tetanusmod.commands.body:
Operator permission level 2:
/rustandruin summon minecraft:spider ~ ~ ~
/rustandruin tetanize @e[type=minecraft:zombie,distance=..10]

Commands bypass natural mutation chances and do not target players.

Sounds:
/playsound tetanusmod:tetanus_effect master @a
/playsound tetanusmod:spasm master @a
/playsound tetanusmod:vomit master @a

Both client and server need Rust & Ruin and Fabric API. No recipe viewer is required.

Configure the server in config/tetanusmod.json while stopped. Existing customized values are preserved.

guide.tetanusmod.salvage.body:
Supported dropped metal rusts after five consecutive seconds touching water or fifteen seconds in exposed rain. Roofs protect against rain. Names, enchantments and damage survive conversion.

A wire brush cleans equipment, costing durability per item and returning one Rust per action. Rust is placeable on floors and walls.

Fishing rods left in water return two sticks and two string, with a fifteen percent hook chance.

A Rusty Hookline pulls targets up to twelve blocks away with a two-second cooldown.

Only permanent tetanized animals drop infected meat; only rabid animals drop rabid meat. Cooking either makes it safe.

guide.tetanusmod.overview.body:
Rust changes what iron can do. Build tools, let them weather, then choose whether to clean them or use the infection.

This guide is read-only and never consumed. Choose a chapter on the left. Use the mouse wheel or arrow buttons to scroll.

The server controls duration and protection chances. Diseases, Prevention and Creatures show its current settings. Weapon statistics and ritual examples use defaults.

JEI and REI are optional. All recipes also work without a viewer.

guide.tetanusmod.diseases.body:
Tetanus: random %s-%s seconds per ordinary infection. Muscle stiffness and spasms develop over time.

Lockjaw Sonata blocks eating during the final 2-4 minutes. A standalone Lockjaw potion lasts one minute. Milk cures neither; antitoxin cures both.

Salmonella causes vomiting, nausea, hunger loss and mild nonlethal damage. Strange Meat requires picking up infected meat; Why did I eat that? requires Salmonella.

Rabies lasts until death or Rabies Cure. Each minute removes one heart of capacity, down to two hearts; nausea then lasts ten seconds every minute. Milk and Tetanus Antitoxin do not cure Rabies.

guide.tetanusmod.brewing.body:
Water + Cow Manure makes Cow Manure Potion, causing five seconds of nausea.

Manure Potion + Rust makes Tetanus.
Manure Potion + Infected Meat makes Salmonella.
Manure Potion + Rabid Meat makes Rabies.
Tetanus Potion + Pufferfish makes Lockjaw Sonata.

Gunpowder makes splash potions; dragon breath makes lingering versions.

Smithing, not brewing: leave template empty; arrows in the base slot, Rust in addition. One Rust coats the entire arrow stack, up to 64.

Tetanus Vaccine: %s%% lower infection risk for %s. It prevents new Tetanus without curing existing illness or Salmonella.

Gloves: right-click to equip in the dedicated glove slot above the offhand slot. %s%% lower contact risk; 192 durability. Shift-click to equip or remove. Gloves do not protect against infected food or potions. Combined vaccine/glove protection: %s%%.

Tetanus Protection: a shield enchantment. A held enchanted shield reduces risk from Tetanus I by 65 percent and Tetanus II by 40 percent.

guide.tetanusmod.bosses.body:
Four Tetanized Soul Sand in the usual Wither T: five percent mutation chance. A netherite upper-center block raises the default chance to thirty percent.

A Tetanized Wither has six hundred health, normal and Tetanized Wither Stars, guaranteed Tetanus I, a fifty percent additional Tetanus II book chance, and bonus loot.

Craft its special star into a Tetanized Beacon. Build the pyramid entirely from Rusted Iron Blocks. Payments remain netherite ingots.

Primary powers start at II; full pyramids offer Regeneration II or a primary upgrade to III. An active beam always grants Tetanus Resistance. Its placement and full activation have separate mod advancements.
